description: Create a public status page at pulse.edge.network/{slug}, showing the checks you choose under the names you choose. Free. It is public as soon as it is created, unless published is false.

components.description: The services shown, in order (up to 50). Send the whole list when changing it.

check_id.description: The check behind the service (from edge_list_pulse_checks)

name.description: The public name. Empty uses the check's name.

custom_domain.description: Serve the page on your own domain, e.g. "status.example.com". BILLABLE: $2 a month, needs a card on file. Point a CNAME at the cnameTarget returned, then verify.

description.description: Introduction under the title, up to 500 characters

dry_run.description: Preview the action without executing it. Returns what would happen, including cost estimates. Always dry-run first for anything that costs money.

logo_url.description: An https:// link to a logo image

published.description: false takes the page offline without deleting it

slug.description: The address after pulse.edge.network/: 3 to 40 lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens

name: edge_create_pulse_status_page
